findings.claim: The clock-1112 full H1 value 1933.04 is a sampled acceleration-residual norm. It is explicitly not a velocity H1 error estimate, residual qualification, or accepted-window result. No source-backed conversion from that number to a velocity error is present.

The frozen complete design requires a quintic-Hermite temporal reconstruction, non-node off-stage probes, refinement, an independent conservative 2N product, and a bound or measured convergence for forcing above that band. The current P10 probe plan instantiates that general contract with three nested actual accepted-node support triples at decreasing spacings. If residuals are used to control reference L2 error, the documented formula is an energy/Gronwall time integral of the L2 defect b(s), amplified by the integral of a strain bound; sampled strain maxima are not rigorous bounds and the estimate may be uninformative.

The current generic verifier accepts caller-supplied tracking discrepancies and eleven empirical channel measurements, including Reconstruction refinement. It neither computes residual coefficients nor temporally integrates them. Its highest successful result is ReadyForLineageReview, explicitly separate from empirical-window acceptance and enclosures.

blocking_check: The residual-specific missing empirical check is a qualified off-stage residual refinement sequence on the same profile: the frozen design's quintic-Hermite, non-node, independently conservative 2N residual contract with controlled force above the represented band, instantiated by the current P10 plan as three nested actual accepted-node support triples at decreasing spacings and bound to a predeclared residual observable/policy across the required fine schedule. The single clock-1112 probe is insufficient. This check is one of several still-missing mandatory channels, so completing it alone cannot accept a window.
implemented_weighting: No Stokes or semigroup-weighted residual estimator is implemented in the inspected current verifier. The frozen design states an L2 energy/Gronwall amplification formula, not a Stokes-semigroup estimator; the current verifier only reviews supplied empirical values and refinements.
residual_to_velocity_bound: No existing implemented residual-to-velocity bound was found in the current Rust verifier or residual diagnostics. The design-only L2 formula requires temporal integration and strain/forcing controls that the current verifier does not compute. It does not yield a velocity H1 bound from the raw H1 acceleration residual.
